name: marian-coach
description: Plugins for engineering leaders by Marian Kamenistak: marian-coach for your own career, engineering-leadership for your team and org.

plugins.name: grow-your-value
plugins.description: Two scores for an engineering leader or developer who wants to earn more. VMS (Value Multiplicator Score): twelve weighted steps give your market value from 0.4 to 1.7 and the three steps that raise it most. Digital footprint score: give it a LinkedIn profile URL and it scores how you look to a recruiter, a hiring manager or an AI screening tool, from public evidence only, with a plan. Then the LinkedIn profile boost advisor rewrites your profile section by section.

plugins.name: marian-coach
plugins.description: Your own career as an engineering leader: are you ready to lead, what are you worth in salary and market value, how do you look from outside, how to rewrite your LinkedIn profile, your one-minute pitch, your promotion case, your first 90 days in a new role, your next 1:1 with your manager, and how do you get your company to pay for mentoring. Built from 3,662 mentoring sessions with engineering leaders since 2019.

plugins.name: engineering-leadership
plugins.description: For your team and your org: delivery KPIs from your Jira data and a 6-sprint plan to fix them, your manager-to-senior-IC split and the question it should prompt, and a go or no-go check before you launch a local leadership community. From the Engineering Leaders Community.

plugins.name: elc-awesome-speaker
plugins.description: Get your talk ready for a conference or meetup stage. speaker-evaluation scores the talk 0-10 on the seven criteria the ELC Conference programme team uses, with a quote behind each score, and writes out the fixes that add the most points. speaker-deck turns the outline into an interactive web deck with one big QR code to something the room can use the next day.
